databaseInfo.name: cefBox Folding Box Dieline Database - Refactored
databaseInfo.disclaimer: This JSON database is a production-oriented parametric schema extracted from public cefBox template pages. Exact production dielines require engineer-verified CAD/DXF geometry and physical prototyping.
databaseInfo.intendedUse: Catalog, UI schema, parameter normalization, validation checklist, and generator input reference for a dieline + 3D mockup application.

globalManufacturingRules.grainDirection: Prefer grain parallel to carton height unless load, material, or printer recommendations require otherwise.
globalManufacturingRules.tolerance: Typical die-cutting +/-0.3mm to +/-0.5mm; confirm with printer and die maker.
globalManufacturingRules.dieCuttingNotes: Use separate named layers/spot colors for CUT, CREASE, PERF, GLUE, BLEED, SAFE. Confirm nick positions and stripping requirements with die maker.
globalManufacturingRules.printingNotes: Extend artwork to bleed boundary; keep important artwork inside safe margin; keep glue/no-varnish zones clear.
globalManufacturingRules.assemblyNotes: Always prototype and test filled product weight before production.

globalValidationRules.message: Material thickness should remain within common folding carton limits unless custom tooling is used.
globalValidationRules.suggestedFix: Choose a suitable paperboard thickness or verify with printer.

globalValidationRules.message: Bleed and safe margins must be practical for printing.
globalValidationRules.suggestedFix: Use 3mm bleed and at least 2-3mm safe margin.

validationRules.condition: length >= 30
validationRules.message: Length must be greater than the minimum manufacturable width/length.

validationRules.condition: width >= 20
validationRules.message: Depth/side width must be greater than minimum manufacturable depth.

validationRules.condition: height >= 30
validationRules.message: Height must support closure mechanism and product clearance.

validationRules.condition: glueFlapWidth >= minimumGlueFlapWidth
validationRules.message: Glue flap must be wide enough for stable side-seam adhesion.

validationRules.condition: glueFlapWidth + length*2 + width*2 <= canvasWidth - bleed*2 + tolerance
validationRules.message: Glue flap must not collide with panels.
validationRules.suggestedFix: Reduce glue flap or increase canvas width.

validationRules.condition: all artwork safeArea >= safetyMargins from cut/fold lines
validationRules.message: Artwork must not enter unsafe fold/cut zones.

validationRules.condition: windowEnabled == false || window edges >= minimumWindowMargin from folds/cuts
validationRules.message: Window must not touch fold, cut, safe, or glue zones.

validationRules.condition: hangHoleEnabled == false || hang hole center remains inside hanger allowed zone
validationRules.message: Hang hole must stay inside allowed hanger zone.

validationRules.condition: lock tabs do not overlap dust flaps, glue flap, or main panels outside allowed slots
validationRules.message: Lock tabs must not overlap invalid zones.
validationRules.suggestedFix: Reduce tab size or increase panel dimensions.

validationRules.condition: auto bottom panels overlap enough for selected material and load
validationRules.message: Auto-lock bottom panels must have enough overlap.
validationRules.suggestedFix: Increase bottom flaps or choose snap/full-flap bottom.

validationRules.condition: snap tabs remain inside their receiving panel area
validationRules.message: Snap-lock tabs must remain inside correct panel area.
validationRules.suggestedFix: Reduce tab length or increase flap height.

validationRules.condition: tearStripEnabled == false || tear strip has margin from folds/cuts >= 5
validationRules.message: Tear strip must have enough margin.

validationRules.condition: dividerEnabled == false || divider fits internal volume length x width x height
validationRules.message: Divider/partition must fit inside internal volume.
validationRules.suggestedFix: Reduce divider dimensions or enlarge box.

validationRules.condition: crease allowance adjusted for materialThickness
validationRules.message: Fold lines must account for selected material thickness.

validationRules.condition: depth >= 20
validationRules.message: Depth must be above the minimum manufacturable size.
validationRules.suggestedFix: Adjust the parameter into the recommended range.

validationRules.condition: bleed >= 0 && safeMargin >= 2
validationRules.message: Bleed and safe margin must be positive and practical.
validationRules.suggestedFix: Adjust the parameter into the recommended range.

validationRules.condition: materialThickness >= 0.25 && materialThickness <= 3
validationRules.message: Material thickness must remain compatible with paperboard folding.
validationRules.suggestedFix: Adjust the parameter into the recommended range.
